title: Correct the host delivery acknowledgement recovery instruction
outcome: An invalid ACK gives a recoverable host procedure that does not implicitly consume the lost page; existing delivery semantics stay unchanged.
acceptance: ACK P can stage P+1; repeated ACK P cannot confirm P+1; explicit ACK P+1 advances it, while no-ACK advancement retains its existing contract.
Focus-only core next observes confirmed/pending without staging or ACK; ACK of confirmed replays identical retained payload/token/through despite later data.
Only ACK recovery remedy, host docs and regressions change; implicit ACK and public API remain unchanged.
Recovery serializes cursor-read, replay and ACK against advancing next and focus changes for the same session; no concurrent exact replay promise.
Remedy and both feature briefs plus host checklist describe the actual recovery commands and distinguish replayed changes from dynamic response sections.
Wrong cursor and matching pending cursor with wrong token refuse while preserving confirmed cursor and retained pending page.

completion.summary: Corrected invalid-ACK recovery instructions for agents and hosts, synchronized all direct docs, and verified state-preserving replay regressions with clean final review.
